range_rule: Category targets and coverage scores range only over this declared set. Observed idea labels do not extend the range. A label outside the set is invalid, not a new category and not extra coverage.
source_note: 11-COUNCIL-SPECIFICATION.schema.json, 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.json, and _USER-PROMPTS.md:10746-10767 / :10915-10946 are absent on this worktree. This taxonomy is the operational closed range this unit supplies for category/coverage/diversity; it is not a claim that those bytes were read here.

categories.description: How a proposed idea works as a mechanism, algorithm, or control.
Agent- or user-facing surface: prompts, APIs, files, UX.
How we know it worked: probes, both-states controls, oracles.
How it breaks, silent-loss shapes, and named residuals.
Cost, quota, budget dials, and exhaustion behaviour.
Who decides, review, roster, recusal, owner gates.
Trust boundaries, secrets, abuse, and authorization.
Run, observe, recover, retry, and operational cadence.

joint_score.name: pielou_evenness_over_declared_taxonomy
joint_score.formula: H / ln(|T|) where H is Shannon entropy of occupancy p_i = n_i / N over every declared category including unoccupied ones (p_i=0 contributes 0 to H). This is one number: unoccupied categories lower H, so coverage and evenness are not separately gated.
joint_score.coverage_definition: C = |{c in T : n_c >= 1}| / |T|. Diagnostic only. Token-coverage (one idea per category, remainder dumped into one popular category) yields C=1.0 and must not pass the joint gate.
